title: A Grizzly Bear Can Eat 40,000 Moths in One Day

scenes.text: One grizzly bear can eat forty thousand moths in a single day.
In summer, Yellowstone grizzlies climb up mountain slopes just to find them.
The moths are packed with fat. Some are up to seventy-five percent fat.
Nothing else in a Yellowstone grizzly's diet packs as many calories.
A month of moths can cover about half of a bear's yearly calories.

description:
A single grizzly bear can eat 40,000 army cutworm moths in one day.
The moths are so rich in fat that a month of them can cover about half a bear's yearly calorie needs.
Would you eat a moth for 8 calories a gram?
first_comment: Bonus: bears frightened by humans eat far fewer moths, which hurts their winter fat. Would you eat a moth if it had the most calories per bite?
